## Decision: SHIP

Ship the **treatment** arm. The primary metric CI excludes zero on the good side and there are no pre-registered guardrails to fail.

## Primary result

- Metric: **visit** (binary, higher is better) [r1]
- Treatment vs control: **+30.2% (95% CI +26.8% to +33.9%), p < 0.0001; absolute +0.01128 (0.0373 -> 0.04858); better** [r3]
- MDE was 2% relative, alpha 0.05, planned n 1,000,000 [r1]

## Guardrails

None pre-registered [r1]. The guardrail condition is therefore satisfied vacuously.

## Validity checks (SRM, peeking, novelty)

- **SRM**: passed. Observed split control 15.01% / treatment 84.99%; chi2 = 0.1387, p = 0.71 [r2].
- **Peeking**: no planned interim looks [r1], so no sequential boundary applies.
- **Novelty**: no daily data available (has_daily = false) [r1], so daily_effects could not be run.

## Caveats

- This is a retrospective case study with placeholder dates [r1].
- No daily-data novelty/decay check is possible, so a decaying effect cannot be ruled out.
- No guardrails were pre-registered; the decision relies on the primary metric alone.

## Exploratory findings

- Secondary metric **conversion**: treatment vs control **+38.4% (95% CI +24.1% to +55.9%), p < 0.0001; absolute +0.0008574 (0.002231 -> 0.003089); better** [r4]. Not part of the ship rule.
- No segments are available for segment_effects [r1].
